answer: Pool the bonds, socialize the losses onto cheaters. Every identity must lock an equal deposit into a shared slashing pool at the inlet to minting; detected fakes forfeit their stake, and those forfeits refund honest participants' bonds plus a dividend. For a farm the arithmetic sinks to its nadir: each extra fake it funds is one more deposit statistically destined for forfeiture, feeding the very pool that pays the honest. One operator cannot grow a vine of personas for free — net capital flows out of the attacker and into defenders in proportion to headcount.
